Absolutely! Here’s a **comprehensive 12-week summary** for your advanced prenatal client, integrating strength, cardio, core, nutrition, and a safe “peak” week. This plan is tailored for her experience, pregnancy stage, and preferences (including upper body pressing and core work), and follows all safety guidelines.

---

# **12-Week Prenatal Strength & Fitness Plan**

## **Programme Overview**
- **Client:** 30, advanced lifter, 20–31 weeks pregnant
- **Frequency:** 3 strength sessions/week + 2–3 cardio sessions/week
- **Intensity:** Moderate (RPE 6–7/10), no max attempts, no supine after week 16
- **Focus:** Maintain strength, lean mass, core stability, and cardiovascular health

---

## **Phase 1: Weeks 1–4 (20–23 weeks) — Foundation & Adaptation**

**Goals:**  
- Maintain strength and muscle  
- Adapt to pregnancy changes  
- Reinforce technique and introduce pregnancy-safe variations

### **Strength Sessions**

**Session A: Lower Body Focus**
- Goblet Squat: 4x8–10
- Trap Bar Deadlift: 3x8
- Reverse Lunge: 3x10/leg
- Glute Bridge (shoulders elevated): 3x12
- Standing Calf Raise: 3x15
- Pallof Press: 3x12/side (core)

**Session B: Upper Body Focus**
- Incline DB Bench Press: 3–4x8–10 (30–45° incline)
- Seated DB Shoulder Press: 3x8–10
- Lat Pulldown: 3x10
- Single-Arm DB Row: 3x10/arm
- Cable Face Pull: 3x12
- Bird Dog: 3x10/side (core)

**Session C: Full Body & Core**
- Sumo Squat: 3x10
- DB Romanian Deadlift: 3x10
- Assisted Pull-Up or Band Row: 3x8–10
- Standing Cable Chest Press: 3x10
- Step-Up: 3x10/leg
- Half-Kneeling Cable Chop: 3x10/side (core)

### **Cardio**
- 2x/week, 20–25 min, moderate intensity (walking, cycling, swimming)

### **Core Focus**
- Bird Dog, Pallof Press, Side Plank (knees), Cat-Cow

---

## **Phase 2: Weeks 5–8 (24–27 weeks) — Intensification**

**Goals:**  
- Maintain and challenge strength  
- Increase training density and volume  
- Use supersets, tempo, and higher reps for intensity

### **Strength Sessions**

**Session A: Lower Body + Core (Supersets & Tempo)**
- Superset: Box Squat (4x10, 3s eccentric) + DB Romanian Deadlift (4x10, 2s pause)
- Superset: DB Split Squat (3x12/leg) + Cable Pull-Through (3x15)
- Banded Lateral Walk: 2x20 steps/side
- Tall Kneeling Pallof Press: 3x15/side (core)

**Session B: Upper Body + Pressing Focus (Supersets & Drop Sets)**
- Superset: Incline DB Bench Press (4x10–12, last set drop set/tempo) + Chest-Supported Row (4x12)
- Superset: Seated Arnold Press (3x10) + Cable External Rotation (3x15/arm)
- Standing Cable Chest Press: 3x12
- Incline Push-Up: 3x10–12 (optional)
- Standing Pallof Press: 3x15/side (core)

**Session C: Full Body + Mobility (Giant Sets & Carries)**
- Giant Set (repeat 3x):  
  - DB Goblet Squat to Box: 12  
  - DB Step-Up: 12/leg  
  - Assisted Pull-Up or Lat Pulldown: 10  
  - Standing Cable Chest Press: 12  
  - Farmer’s Carry: 30m
- World’s Greatest Stretch: 2x5/side
- Side-Lying Clamshell: 3x20/side

### **Cardio**
- 2–3x/week, 25–30 min, moderate intensity (add intervals: 2 min brisk, 2 min easy)

### **Core Focus**
- Standing Pallof Press, Half-Kneeling Cable Chop, Quadruped Plank Hold, Farmer’s Carry, Bird Dog with Pause

---

## **Phase 3: Weeks 9–12 (28–31 weeks) — Maintenance & Function**

**Goals:**  
- Maintain muscle and function  
- Prioritize comfort and safety  
- Focus on functional movement, core, and pelvic floor

### **Strength Sessions**

**Session A: Lower Body + Glutes**
- Box Squat or Supported Squat: 3x8–10
- DB Romanian Deadlift: 3x10
- Cable Kickback: 3x12/leg
- Standing Calf Raise: 3x15
- Standing Pallof Press: 3x12/side (core)

**Session B: Upper Body + Back & Pressing**
- Incline DB Bench Press: 3x8–10
- Seated Arnold Press: 3x8–10
- Chest-Supported Row: 3x10
- Cable Face Pull: 3x12
- Standing Cable Chest Press: 3x10–12
- Bird Dog: 3x10/side (core)

**Session C: Full Body + Core & Mobility**
- DB Step-Up: 3x10/leg
- Sumo Squat: 3x10
- Assisted Pull-Up or Band Row: 3x8–10
- Standing Cable Chest Press: 3x10
- Half-Kneeling Cable Chop: 3x10/side (core)
- Suitcase Carry: 3x20m/side (core)
- Side Plank (knees or feet): 3x20–30s/side
- Cat-Cow Stretch: 2x10

### **Cardio**
- 2–3x/week, 20–30 min, moderate intensity (steady-state or gentle intervals)

### **Core Focus**
- Standing Anti-Rotation Hold, Suitcase Carry, Side Plank, Half-Kneeling Cable Lift, Seated Band March

---

## **Peak Week (Week 12) — Performance, Not Maximal Testing**

- **No 1RM testing.**
- Use AMRAP (as many reps as possible) sets at moderate loads (8–10RM) for main lifts (e.g., incline DB bench, box squat, Arnold press), stopping at RPE 8/10 or if form breaks.
- Celebrate progress in reps, form, and confidence.
- Optional: Farmer’s Carry for max distance in 1 min, Pallof Press hold for max time.

---

## **Nutrition Plan**

- **Calories:** +300 kcal/day (2nd trimester), +400–450 kcal/day (3rd trimester) above pre-pregnancy maintenance
- **Protein:** 1.6–2.0 g/kg pre-pregnancy bodyweight/day
- **Carbs:** 45–55% of total calories (whole grains, fruit, starchy veg)
- **Fat:** 25–35% of total calories (focus on healthy fats, omega-3s)
- **Micronutrients:** Emphasize folate, iron, calcium, vitamin D, iodine, choline, DHA/EPA (prenatal vitamin + food sources)
- **Hydration:** 2.5–3L/day
- **Meal Structure:** 3 main meals + 2–3 snacks; pre- and post-workout nutrition
- **Supplements:** Prenatal multivitamin, vitamin D, DHA/EPA, protein powder if needed

---

## **Cardio Plan**

- **2–3x/week, 20–30 min/session**
- **Intensity:** Moderate (RPE 5–7/10, conversational pace)
- **Modalities:** Walking, stationary cycling, elliptical, swimming, low-impact group fitness
- **Progression:** Slightly increase duration or add intervals in Phase 2; reduce if fatigue increases in Phase 3

---

## **Core Training**

- **2–3 exercises per session, integrated into strength days**
- **Focus:** Anti-extension, anti-rotation, pelvic floor, breathing
- **Progression:** Increase time, reps, or challenge (not load)
- **Sample exercises:** Pallof Press, Bird Dog, Side Plank, Farmer’s/Suitcase Carry, Cable Chop/Lift, Quadruped Plank

---

## **Safety & Recovery**

- **No supine after week 16**
- **No maximal lifts or Valsalva**
- **Monitor for warning signs (bleeding, dizziness, pain, etc.)**
- **Prioritize sleep, hydration, and gentle stretching**
- **Refer to OB or dietitian as needed**

---

## **Summary Table**

| Phase | Focus                | Strength Highlights                | Cardio                | Core/Accessory Highlights         |
|-------|----------------------|------------------------------------|-----------------------|-----------------------------------|
| 1     | Foundation           | Goblet squat, incline bench, RDL   | 2x/week, 20–25 min    | Bird dog, Pallof, side plank      |
| 2     | Intensification      | Supersets, tempo, pressing focus   | 2–3x/week, 25–30 min  | Standing Pallof, chop, carries    |
| 3     | Maintenance/Function | Comfort, functional, pressing      | 2–3x/week, 20–30 min  | Anti-rotation, suitcase carry     |
| 12    | Peak (no 1RM)        | AMRAP sets, performance benchmarks | As above              | Max time/distance holds/carries   |

---

**This plan keeps her strong, empowered, and safe—supporting her love of lifting, her core, and her pregnancy journey. Adjust as needed for comfort and energy, and celebrate her progress every step of the way!**
